_note: Scored 10 days ago but on model v5. Inside the window yet on a superseded rubric, so the gate must RE-SCORE. This is the case a date-only gate gets wrong.
_icp_symbolic_help: The harness (tests/static/harness.mjs) expands these symbolic keys into hashed custom_fields using CONFIG, so the fixture stays readable and survives create_fields replacing the placeholder keys with real ones. `@days_ago:N` is resolved against CONFIG.now_iso at test time, so 'fresh' and 'stale' cannot rot into each other as the calendar moves.
